summary: IEEE-library form of single-phase series-connected ac motor: this representation distinguishes the publisher's single-phase AC motor with series connection.
description: This reference locates single-phase series-connected ac motor in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented 1 phase motors family. This representation distinguishes the publisher's single-phase AC motor with series connection. The public library uses HMO1M10 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
